pageProps.title: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh at HarbourFront Centre
pageProps.review: The HarbourFront Centre branch of Song Fa Bak Kut Teh in Singapore is a great spot where you can enjoy unlimited refills of a deep garlic and peppery broth, similar to Korean Galbi-tang, in a pleasant mall environment.

## Review
Since the main branch of Song Fa Bak Kut Teh is often crowded and described as less pleasant, I headed to this cleaner branch.  

Being located inside a mall, the interior was definitely comfortable and cool.  
There was a wait, but I was able to enter without waiting too long.  

The taste was familiar, similar to Korean Galbi-tang.  
The broth is a bit clearer and oilier than Galbi-tang, but the strong garlic and pepper notes made it very enjoyable.  

The soup is refillable, and rice must be ordered separately.
